name: Sulekha Sarkar

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sulekha Sarkar is a poet and researcher associated with Siliguri in the Darjeeling region of West Bengal. A 2025 contributor note in Literary Vibes also describes her work in journalism and literary publishing, including the journal Care of Darjeeling. Her English poems appear in both Literary Vibes and Kabita Live.

Her poems here use sharply physical images to explore intimacy and the need for personal space. ‘The Girl with Four Walls’ turns walls into surfaces for flight, sea and freedom, while weather imagery gives the girl's changing feelings a visible form. ‘You're Nowhere’ makes absence difficult to separate from the wound it leaves. In ‘Unlikely man’, the camera, artificial tears and a cup of tea unsettle the boundary between performance and encounter.
